title: R3.0D Capability Ledger
note: Defines each capability the R3.0D phase of the Integrated Delivery Train may eventually enable, its kind, and the earliest checkpoint at which it may be unlocked. A capability being DEFINED here does NOT mean it is ENABLED. Enablement is governed by governance/r3.0d/state.json (enabledCapabilities). D0 only defines the universe; no production capability is enabled at D0.

contract_foundation_present.description: R3.0D D1 contracts present under contracts/r3.0d/ (Evidence / Hypothesis / Recommendation / Engineer Brief / Hypothesis categories). NON-PRODUCTION at D1: no rendererAdapter, no runtime consumer, no algorithm.

governance_bootstrap_present.description: R3.0D Integrated Delivery Governance scaffold present: schema, state, capabilities, checkpoint-manifest schema, and integration with the train-level validators.

hypothesis_engine_present.description: Renderer module that derives Hypothesis objects from Evidence/Observation/Comparison data. Deterministic; non-LLM; preserves the 12-category enum verbatim (no sub-categories).

priority_engine_present.description: Priority engine that ranks hypotheses by severity / repeatability / confidence / evidence-count / cross-lap-consistency / affected-corner-count / controllability / safety / data-quality / expected-validation-cost (frozen enum order). Outputs max 1 primary + 2 secondary, rest in backlog.

engineer_brief_present.description: Engineer Brief generator producing a structured object (what / where / evidence / may-mean / does-not-prove / most-likely-category / alternatives / recommended-next-test / expected-metric-movement / stop-conditions / confidence). NEVER markdown; UI renders the structure. NEVER LLM free text.

feature_registry_active.description: Feature Registry registers the R3.0D feature IDs (decision_engine / hypothesis / engineer_brief — to be named exactly at D5 authorization time) as available, attaching their rendererAdapter. Only valid at D5.
